summary: Reuse one operational failure and recovery history fold within a fault snapshot

replay.detail: No replay or projection rebuild is introduced.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes, triggers or schema version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, replication, canonical ordering or fault-delivery policy changes.

compatibility.detail: The two fault-snapshot consumers share the operational history cut at its existing first-use point; a concurrent history change after that cut is seen by a later invocation. Authority checks, ordering and recovery predicates are unchanged. Standalone attention calls still fold independently; no client, wire or harness interface changes.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or migration is required by this change; production timing and CPU savings are unmeasured.

recovery.detail: No persisted state is changed by this read-path refactor. Reverting the code restores two independent history folds without a data migration.
